storyTitle: Track Holiday Progress & Apply Statement Credit
oneSentenceStory: Daniel reviews his 7,300 coin balance and holiday savings goal progress before executing a direct statement credit redemption.
customerSituation: Daniel visits the rewards overview to check his coin balance and monitor his 53% complete holiday savings goal.
storyTension: Ensuring earned value is clearly visible and directly translatable to bill reduction without navigating irrelevant partner vouchers.
customerResolution: Points and cashback are clearly displayed alongside a one-tap statement credit application shortcut.
primaryOutcome: Review rewards and execute predictable payment-linked redemptions or goal tracking.
